# UPD-006: No pending security updates

- **Group:** Updates
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

A security update that is available and not installed is an open known vulnerability. The check simulates `apt-get upgrade`, which needs no root and installs nothing, and counts the updates that come from a security pocket. It reflects the package lists as of the last apt update.

## Verify by hand

```sh
apt-get -s upgrade | grep -i security
```

## How to fix it

apt update && apt upgrade

Run `stackward explain UPD-006` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
